'''''Trole''''' was a [[Delta-class DX-9 stormtrooper transport|''Delta''-class DX-9 stormtrooper transport]] the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] employed during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==History==
The transport was present at an [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] base which housed [[RZ-1 A-wing interceptor/Legends|A-wings]], [[A/SF-01 B-wing starfighter/Legends|B-wings]] [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|Y-wings]], [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wings]] and [[Z-95 Headhunter/Legends|Z-95 Headhunters]]. The base was attacked by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate/Legends|Nebulon-B frigate]] [[Lightning (EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate)|''Lightning'']]. The transport was destroyed, along with the rest of the base. The events regarding the Imperial attack were recorded and recreated as a training mission in the [[Combat chamber]] to train future [[TIE pilot|pilots]] such as [[Maarek Stele/Legends|Maarek Stele]].
